Scenario: An active caller with a recognized ANI verifies identity with member ID and date of birth.
Pass Criteria: Identity is confirmed and the main menu is offered.

Scenario: An authenticated caller asks for coverage status and the effective date.
Pass Criteria: The coverage status and effective date are both provided.

Scenario: The authenticated caller requests coverage status and the effective date is provided.
Pass Criteria: Coverage status and the effective date are provided to the caller.

Scenario: A caller on a landline requests a replacement member card and cannot receive a text message.
Pass Criteria: No text message is sent and physical mail is confirmed.

Scenario: A caller on a mobile handset requests a replacement member card by text message.
Pass Criteria: A confirmation is spoken and a text message is sent.
Mock Data Persona: Active user on a mobile handset

Scenario: A caller asks to cancel service; the privacy restriction prohibits self service and the system disconnects.
Pass Criteria: The guardrail message plays and the call ends.

Scenario: The billing service returns a system failure while the caller asks for a balance.
Pass Criteria: An error message plays and a transfer is offered.

Scenario: A caller asks about a single paid record from a recent date of service.
Pass Criteria: The record status, date of service and amount are provided.
Mock Data Persona: Active user with one paid record
